items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Benny paid Harry James $500 a week when I was making $40 a week or something. And Ziggy Elman and Krupa.

ctx.x: Was that a salary so no matter how many nights you played, you got the same amount of money?

Well there was union scale for every job you play. There was a road scale for theaters and in those days it was $72 a week. You could play a hundred shows a week and you’d get $72. It wasn’t good. If you were a star of course, you could demand your salary. But the Miller band never really had any salaried, like Benny — Benny paid Harry James $500 a week when I was making $40 a week or something. And Ziggy Elman and Krupa. But they were making — Miller was in debt when he first started his success, and paid that…
